stop_rule.initial_stop: min(previous low, signal low, MA20) * (1 - stop_buffer_pct)

position_sizing.research_dataset: 1-share independent tracking; no cash or portfolio constraints.

filters.sepa_filter: candidate pool/scoring only; not a hard pullback detector filter
filters.rs_filter: candidate pool/scoring only; not a hard pullback detector filter

limitations: Historical sector rank is only available for dates present in sector_rotation history; older pullback trades may have null sector_rank.
Historical sector breadth, sector RS and sector rank-change fields are reserved in the trade snapshot, but remain null until point-in-time sector history is connected.
Historical RS point-in-time snapshots are not available yet, so rs_5d_ago/rs_10d_ago/rs_20d_ago are null; rs_change_* currently uses adjusted price return as a first-pass proxy.
Stored fundamental_score, sepa_score and relative_strength are the project snapshot values attached to generated plans, not a complete point-in-time fundamental history.
Market regime fields come from the plan snapshot available in generated data; verify historical regime availability before using as production research evidence.
Higher-low delayed entry experiments are represented as stricter same-day filters in this first pass; full delayed signal regeneration is pending.
J1 no-volume and H delayed-entry experiments are proxy comparisons on the existing signal dataset, not full regenerated signal universes.
Stop experiments keep account risk fixed by reporting position_size_adjustment, but exits are first-pass stop-distance sensitivities rather than full path-resimulated alternate trade ledgers.
CAGR and account-level exposure metrics are not computed for independent 1-share signal research.

required_evidence: A filter improves expectancy and Profit Factor without collapsing trade count.
Improvement persists across years or walk-forward test periods.
Bootstrap confidence intervals do not show purely noisy uplift.
Failure mode reduction maps to the intended mechanism, e.g. ER filter reduces WHIPSAW.
